verdict.rationale: Weave's docs say you can evaluate responses with LLM judges and custom scorers. Scorers plug into the `Evaluation` object and return dictionaries of metrics, and a documented workflow scores single- and multi-turn agents with an LLM judge. Custom Scorers let you encode your own criteria beyond the predefined ones, such as hallucination and summarization quality, which covers the configurable part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configuring the judge itself (judge model selection, prompt/rubric templates, built-in LLM-judge scorer parameters), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
